problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14108214/assets/67eeabfcff4eb24e14c15691c1c9de746a8870808197739577f7696faeada5bc.png)

Describe the shaded region shown above using set-builder notation.

$$
{(x,y)\in {{field-1}}\,:\,y\,{{field-2}}\,4,\,y\,{{field-3}}\,4x+1}
$$
worked_solution:
The points in our set include all those that lie *below* the line $y=4$ and *below* the line $y=4x+1.$

A point $P(x,y)$ lies *inside* the shaded region if the following conditions are satisfied:

$$
y<4,\,y<4x+1.
$$

We must also include the lines $y=4$ and $y=4x+1$ since the boundaries are included in the set (the lines are solid). So, we change the corresponding inequality symbols above as follows:

$$
y\le 4,\,y\le 4x+1
$$

Moreover, since we're considering *every* real value in this region, $x\in R,y\in R,$ and therefore 

$$
(x,y)\in R\times R={R}^{2}.
$$

Therefore, we can write the set as

$$
{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}\,:\,y\le 4,\,y\le 4x+1}.
$$
